resources.string: Start or stop a meeting recording
Lock the screen — it keeps running
A foreground service with an ongoing notification. Stop it from the notification or the widget without unlocking.
Nothing above the noise floor for 45 seconds
Most often something is over the mic, or another app has grabbed the audio input. The file is still being written either way.
Audio captured now is saved and queued; it transcribes automatically the moment the download lands. You do not have to wait here.
Every meeting and transcript as one file you keep.
Adds the meetings from a Scribe backup. Nothing already here is replaced.
Recommended. The transcript is kept; only the recording is removed, and only once it has been transcribed.
Every meeting, transcript and recording on this phone.
Records a meeting and turns it into a timestamped transcript, entirely on this phone. No account, no upload, works in aeroplane mode.
Recording other people has rules that vary by jurisdiction and employer. That part is on you.
